texts:
Market Run for Week 8: the waiver wire in priority order, with the reason and rest-of-season rank for each. No FAAB bids; your league, your budget.

Top claim: #Skol Jordan Mason.
Next: #BroncosCountry Jonah Coleman.
Deep cut: #DallasCowboys Ryan Flournoy.

Let's get to it.

#Skol Jordan Mason, MIN RB: 38 snaps to Aaron Jones Sr.'s 15 vs IND in his first game off IR, and 15 carries for 68.
Jones is day to day with the knee.
RB26 rest of season for me, RB22 this week at DET. Claim him. Top priority.

#BroncosCountry Jonah Coleman, DEN RB: 30 snaps at ARI in his first game off IR, 49 percent and the most of any Denver back.
RJ Harvey played 16 snaps and J.K. Dobbins 14.
RB27 rest of season for me. Claim him.

#JetUp Omar Cooper Jr., NYJ WR: ran a route on 70 percent of the dropbacks vs MIA and caught 5 for 115 and a TD.
WR35 rest of season for me, WR23 this week vs LV. Claim him if he is still on your wire.

#PhinsUp Ollie Gordon II, MIA RB: 25 carries for 103 and a TD at NYJ on 83 percent of the snaps.
Jaylen Wright (quad) is open for Week 8 vs NE.
RB19 rest of season for me. Add him wherever he is a free agent.

#DawgPound KC Concepcion Jr., CLE WR: 8 of 10 targets for 129 at TEN, the most targets on the Browns. His target share went 3, 24 and 29 percent, and the 3 was a first-quarter concussion exit.
WR37 rest of season for me. Add him.

#RaiderNation Tre Tucker, LV WR: his targets went 5, 7 and 12 over Weeks 5 to 7, and he caught 5 for 103 and a TD vs LAR on 82 percent of the snaps.
WR40 rest of season for me. Claim him.

#RaiseHail Antonio Williams, WAS WR: led Washington's receivers with 45 snaps in Week 6, and Dan Quinn says more chances are coming with Terry McLaurin out for the season.
WR46 rest of season for me. Claim him.

#RaiseHail Chig Okonkwo, WAS TE: caught all 7 targets for 69 at SF in Week 6, after a team-high 6 targets vs NYG in Week 5.
TE16 rest of season for me, TE14 this week vs PHI. Add him.

#FlyEaglesFly Makai Lemon, PHI WR: 7 of 8 targets for 67 and a TD vs DAL Monday on 91 percent of the snaps, mostly from the slot.
DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks were inactive.
WR50 rest of season for me. Add him before Smith's Wednesday practice report.

#BirdGang Jacoby Brissett, ARI QB: 27 of 48 for 272 and a TD vs DEN with Carson Beck's back acting up.
Arizona plays at DAL Sunday.
QB11 for me this week, a borderline start. Stream him; Wednesday's practice report decides whether Beck takes it back.

#Skol T.J. Hockenson, MIN TE: 76 percent of the snaps vs IND and 4 of 5 targets for 35 and a TD.
TE10 for me this week at DET. Stream him if your tight end is on bye or hurt.

#DallasCowboys Ryan Flournoy, DAL WR: 4 of 4 for 70 at PHI, 13 targets to Jake Ferguson's 4 in two weeks.
WR60 rest of season for me. Add him in deep leagues.

Jake Ferguson, DAL TE: target share 14, 6 and 4 percent since Week 5.
TE28 rest of season for me. Drop him.

Stashes.

#Seahawks Jadarian Price, SEA RB: designated to return from IR this week.
RB48 rest of season for me. Stash him.

#FTTB Kaelon Black, SF RB: 12 for 63 and a TD at ATL, with all 3 carries inside the 5.
RB46 rest of season for me. Stash him in deep leagues.

#ForTheShoe Seth McGowan, IND RB: 11 carries for 46 on 18 snaps vs MIN, both season highs, behind Jonathan Taylor's 41 snaps.
The trade deadline is Nov 10 at 4 PM ET.
RB61 rest of season for me. Stash him in deep leagues through the deadline.

Cut bait.

#NYGiants Tyrone Tracy Jr., NYG RB: on IR with the hamstring, at least four games.
RB63 rest of season for me. Drop him unless you have an IR spot.

#WhoDey Erick All Jr., CIN TE: on IR, torn ACL feared.
TE53 rest of season for me. Drop him.

#BroncosCountry J.K. Dobbins, DEN RB: 14 snaps at ARI, down from 52 percent the two weeks before.
RB42 rest of season for me. Drop him.

#RaiderNation Mike Washington Jr., LV RB: 18 snaps vs LAR as Ashton Jeanty went back to 72 percent.
RB45 rest of season for me. Drop him.

#PhinsUp Caleb Douglas, MIA WR: 2 TDs on 3 targets at NYJ, 14 percent of the throws. Three targets do not make a role, so he is not on this list.
WR52 rest of season for me. Sell him where he is rostered.

Monday night, Dallas 38, Philadelphia 21.

#DallasCowboys Javonte Williams, DAL RB: 25 carries for a career-high 155 and a TD, with no targets.
RB8 rest of season for me. Sell him on the 155.

#FlyEaglesFly Saquon Barkley, PHI RB: 10 snaps Monday, a hamstring tweak and a sore back; he says he plays at WAS.
RB18 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles report.

Dameon Pierce, PHI RB: 14 for 47 and a TD, then hurt.
Monitor the same report.

#DallasCowboys CeeDee Lamb, DAL WR: 12 targets at PHI and 2 TDs.
WR5 rest of season for me. Hold him.

#FlyEaglesFly Elijah Mitchell, PHI RB: the only Eagles back left at the end, 14 snaps.
RB90 rest of season for me. Add him in deep leagues only if Pierce is ruled out.

Every add, stash and drop, with the reasons and the ranks, is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Menu and every call through Sunday, and send this to your league before claims run.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/market.html?week=8
